violated_contract: A Review question whose offered premise is permanently invalid must settle its proposal. Releasing every conflict back to offered leaves the proposal pending and serves the same unanswerable question on each app open.
canonical_prevention: Classify permanent invalidation as ReviewStale and atomically settle the offered answer, refund its reserved attention slot, and resolve only the matching proposal evidence version. Already-true affirmative identity answers settle successfully without another merge. Preserve retryable lease and transactional fence conflicts through wrappers and release those reservations instead.
